blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Football Club (Cebu FC) Gentle Giants continued their resurgence in the Philippines Football League (PFL) Season 2026–2027, notching their third straight victory with a dominant 9–0 rout of Philippine Army FC on Sunday, November 22, at the Rizal Memorial Stadium in Manila. After opening their campaign with back-to-back defeats, the Gentle Giants have bounced back strongly, stringing together three consecutive wins victories to improve their record to three wins and two losses. The emphatic win also gave Cebu FC one of the season’s biggest winning margins, boosting its campaign as it climbed to sixth place […]...
